name: Better ST for Bose SoundTouch
description:
Hinweis: Die Benutzeroberfläche der App ist jetzt auf Deutsch verfügbar.

Sorgen, dass das Internetradio verschwindet, wenn die Bose-Server oder TuneIn abschalten? Suchst du eine schnelle, zuverlässige und moderne Steuerungs-App für deine SoundTouch-Lautsprecher? Hier ist sie. Better ST sorgt dafür, dass deine Musik weiterläuft.

Key Features:

• Sofort startklar: Keine Konten. Keine Bose-Server. Kein Tracking. Better ST startet sofort, erkennt deine Geräte automatisch im lokalen Netzwerk und respektiert deine Privatsphäre. Einfach öffnen und abspielen.

• Hardware-Preset-Tasten funktionieren weiterhin: Der Better ST-Server hilft dabei, einen Teil der offiziellen Serverfunktionen wiederherzustellen, sodass du deine geliebten physischen Preset-Tasten weiter nutzen kannst. Einmal konfiguriert, laufen deine Lautsprecher völlig unabhängig, ohne auf dein Smartphone angewiesen zu sein.

• Super-Presets (Szenen): Gehe über einfache Radiosender hinaus. Erstelle benutzerdefinierte "Szenen"-Tasten für den Party-Modus – synchronisiere Multi-Room-Gruppen sofort und lege spezifische Lautstärken für jeden Lautsprecher fest (z. B. "Spiele Jazz in Küche & Wohnzimmer auf 20%") mit nur einem Tippen.

• Liquid Glass UI: Schnell, flüssig und exklusiv für iOS 26 entwickelt. Erlebe eine atemberaubende, native Benutzeroberfläche, die sich auf deinem iPhone oder iPad genau richtig anfühlt.

• Sofortiger Zugriff: Siehe auf einen Blick, was gerade läuft, und steuere Play/Pause. Das Beste daran: Starte deine Super-Presets direkt von deinem Home-Bildschirm aus, um deine perfekte Szene zu aktivieren, ohne die App überhaupt öffnen zu müssen.

• Weltweites Radio: Unterstützt von Radio Browser, bietet dir integrierten Zugriff auf eine riesige Bibliothek mit Tausenden von weltweiten Sendern, filterbar nach Land, Genre und Qualität.

• Siri Kurzbefehle & Magic Wake: Soll dein Lautsprecher zusammen mit deinem morgendlichen Wecker starten? Nutze unsere leistungsstarke Kurzbefehle-Integration (Shortcuts), um eine "Magic Wake"-Automation zu erstellen und deinen SoundTouch in deine täglichen iOS-Routinen zu integrieren.

• Volle Fernsteuerung: Meistere deinen Sound mit Präzision. Verwalte Lautstärke, Wiedergabe, Gerätegruppierung (Multi-Room) und passe deinen Ton mit speziellen EQ-Einstellungen an.

• Mixtape-Modus (NAS): Verwandle deine lokalen NAS-Ordner in eine Retro-Musikbibliothek. Stelle deine Lieblingssammlungen zu virtuellen Kassetten zusammen für eine echte lückenlose Wiedergabe (Gapless Playback).

Technische Details & Hardware-Steuerung:
Zu den unterstützten Hardware-Funktionen gehören:

• Allgemeine Systeme: Lautsprecher umbenennen, Basspegel anpassen, Gruppeneinstellungen für Video Sync ändern und den Auto-Off-Timer bei den meisten SoundTouch-Geräten deaktivieren.
• SoundTouch 20 / 30 / Portable: Das vordere LED-Uhrendisplay ein- und ausschalten.
• SoundTouch 300 & Lifestyle 550/600/650: Zugriff auf erweiterte Heimkino-Einstellungen. Passe die Lautstärke des Center-Kanals und der Surround-Lautsprecher individuell an, verwalte HDMI-CEC-Einstellungen, aktiviere HDMI-In, weise die Quellentaste auf deiner Fernbedienung zu und schalte die Lautsprecherauswahl um.
(Hinweis: Die Verfügbarkeit bestimmter Hardware-Einstellungen hängt von deinem genauen SoundTouch-Modell und der aktuellen Firmware-Version ab.)

Haftungsausschluss: Diese Anwendung wird nur zwischen dem Entwickler und dem Endbenutzer abgeschlossen und nicht mit Bose. Bose unterstützt, genehmigt oder sponsert diese Anwendung in keiner Weise. Bose und SoundTouch sind Marken der Bose Corporation.

Nutzungsbedingungen (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Moment Pro Camera II
description:
Your Camera, Your Looks, Your Way.

Moment Pro Camera II turns your phone into your favorite camera for photography and filmmaking. Shoot like a pro with full manual controls, creative looks, and an upgraded interface – all in one intuitive app.

What’s New in Pro Camera II?

Our first pro camera app has been the #1 rated camera app for years. Now, it’s time for the next chapter. We’ve re-engineered Pro Camera II from the ground up to give you better performance, advanced controls, and new customizable interfaces and shooting modes.

Key Features:

• Pro-Level Exposure Control – Our smart exposure system allows you to take control with Shutter Priority, ISO Priority, Manual, and Auto exposure modes, including the ability to limit Auto ISO to a specific range.
• Upgraded White Balance – Beyond auto white balance, you can manually configure temperature and tint, choose a preset, or calibrate via a gray card.
• Advanced Photo Options – Control the level of processing and HDR applied to your photos. Shoot in RAW, ProRAW, TIFF, HEIF, or JPG.
• Cinematic Video Tools – Apple Log, Open Gate, ProRes, 10-bit recording, and more. Adjust the resolution, color space, frame rate, codec, bitrate, and chroma subsampling for total creative freedom.
• Precision Monitoring – Get pro-level feedback with Waveform, RGB Histograms, and audio meters — normally reserved for cinema cameras.
• Aspect Ratio – Frame your shot within your favorite aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, 3:2, 5:4, 1:1)
• Designed for All Creators – A beautiful, intuitive interface that adapts to how you shoot. Swipe, tap, and adjust anything immediately with one hand (including a dedicated left-handed layout), or go distraction-free with Zen Mode. Works natively in landscape orientation.
• Looks, Your Way – Apply creative Looks or import your own LUTs to video and photos. Preview them live, bake them into your footage, or adjust intensity on the fly.
• Focus Tools That Just Work – Separate reticles for exposure and focus with a tap, or dial in the shot with Manual Focus and Focus Peaking.
• Quick Actions, Faster Shooting – One swipe to reach your most used tools: flash, stabilization, zebras, focus peaking, grids, and more.
• Intuitive Lens Control – Remove the guesswork of which lens you are using and eliminate surprises with our Optic Controls. Say goodbye to shaky zoom with our fluid zoom control.
• Hardware-Ready – Optimized for every iPhone, with seamless integration for external mics and Moment’s entire lens + case ecosystem.

Upcoming Feature Releases
• Look Store: purchase creator color grades and film emulations
• Slow Shutter and Timelapse modes
• Advanced Profile sharing and collaboration tools
• Extended hardware integration partnerships

We love hearing from our community. For feature requests, ideas, or support, email us at hello@shopmoment.com or message us @momentprocamera on social media.

Fully Compatible with iPhone and Moment's complete ecosystem of lenses, cases, and accessories.

name: Network Analyzer Pro: IP Tools
description:
Network Analyzer Pro is a complete network toolkit that turns your iPhone or iPad into a powerful diagnostic instrument. Whether you are troubleshooting a slow connection, tracking down unknown devices, or exploring how the internet routes your traffic, it puts professional-grade tools right in your pocket - no desktop or extra hardware required.

Discover every device on your LAN, watch your traceroute unfold on a world map, measure your real download and upload speeds, work out any subnet with the IP calculator, and diagnose any host with ping, traceroute, port scanning, DNS lookup, and whois. From home users to IT professionals, Network Analyzer Pro delivers everything you need in one polished app.

LAN scanner:
- Fast and reliable detection of all devices on Wi-Fi, VPN, and personal hotspot networks
- IP addresses, MAC addresses, and vendors of all discovered devices
- NetBIOS, mDNS (Bonjour), LLMNR, DNS, SNMP, and WS-Discovery names
- Reachability (ping) test, IPv6 availability, and IPv6 addresses
- Custom device names and vendors, scan history, and favorites
- Quick actions: open the web interface, browse Bonjour and UPnP services, or wake the device
- Wake on LAN (WOL) including remote WOL
- Scan of custom IP ranges, filtering, and search in the device list

Ping & traceroute:
- Round-trip delay, IP address, and hostname for every node
- Selectable ICMP, UDP, and TCP ping and ICMP/UDP traceroute probes
- Configurable probe delay, payload size, TCP port, and don't-fragment flag
- Audible ping
- Geolocation (latitude, longitude, country, city, time zone), AS number, and network name
- Complete traceroute visualization on the map
- Real-time graphical ping statistics

Port scanner:
- Scan common ports, custom ranges, or the complete port range
- Detection of closed, firewalled, and open ports
- Descriptions of known port services
- Editable common port list and adjustable scan rate

Whois:
- Look up domains, IP addresses, and AS numbers
- Classic whois and the modern RDAP protocol, with custom servers

DNS lookup:
- Functionality similar to nslookup or dig
- Query all record types at once or a single type
- A, AAAA, CAA, CNAME, HINFO, LOC, MX, NAPTR, NS, PTR, SOA, SPF, SRV, SSHFP, and TXT records
- DNSSEC records: DNSKEY, CDNSKEY, RRSIG, NSEC3PARAM, NSEC, NSEC3, DS, CDS, TLSA
- Custom DNS server and port, no-recursion option, all response sections

Internet speed:
- Download, upload, and server latency measurement
- Graphical speed test view
- History with full results including graphs, custom names, and notes

IP calculator:
- Details about any IPv4 or IPv6 address, range, or subnet
- Network, broadcast, masks, address count, type, class, IANA block, reverse DNS, supernet, subnet splitting, membership test
- Binary, decimal, hex, and IPv6 forms (expanded, 6to4, NAT64, Teredo, EUI-64)

MAC address browser:
- Vendor lookup (IEEE MA-L, MA-M, MA-S), address type, administration, SLAP quadrant, and known use
- Custom name and vendor assignment used throughout the app

Network information:
- Default gateway, DNS server, HTTP proxy, external IP (v4 and v6) with hostname, AS number, and AS name
- Wi-Fi details: SSID, BSSID, router vendor, security type, IP address, and subnet mask
- VPN, USB Ethernet, and personal hotspot connection details
- Cell network type, with dual SIM support
- Wi-Fi, cell, and VPN data usage since the last boot

Local service discovery:
- Bonjour and UPnP/DLNA browsers

Siri, Shortcuts, and controls:
- Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts app support for every tool
- Control Center, Lock Screen, and Action button controls
- Share extension: query any website from Safari
- Home screen quick actions

More:
- No ads
- Light and dark theme
- Full IPv6 support everywhere, with selectable IPv4/IPv6
- History of all performed tasks, with favorites
- Export by email, AirPrint, and AirDrop
- Copy/paste support
- Detailed help
- Regular updates

name: Blitzrechnen Schulversion
description:
Hier ist die Schulversion der Blitzrechnen-App! Sie kaufen einmal und erhalten mit einer App Zugriff auf die Inhalte aller Schuljahre. Es ist nicht nötig, In-App-Käufe zu tätigen. Alle 4 Klassenstufen sind sofort enthalten. 


Apps für die Grundschule

Lernerfolg und Motivation ist mit den mit den Grundschul-Apps garantiert: Die Bedienung der Apps ist für jedes Kind einfach und ohne große Erklärung möglich - im Unterricht und zu Hause. Die Lerninhalte werden selbstständig und spielerisch geübt. Die Lern-Apps ermöglichen zudem einen sinnvollen Umgang mit digitalen Endgeräten, bieten Abwechslung zu den klassischen Übungsformen und stärken die Medienkompetenz der Kinder. Offline anwendbar garantieren die Apps eine zuverlässige Nutzung – ohne Zugangsbeschränkungen und überall.

Mit der Blitzrechnen-App können die Lerninhalte des Mathematik Unterrichts von Klasse 1 bis 4 selbstständig zu Hause oder im Klassenraum geübt werden. Dabei sind die Inhalte jedes Schuljahres enthalten, so dass die App klassenstufenübergreifend über die gesamte Grundschulzeit genutzt werden kann.

Das kann die Blitzrechnen-App:
• Passgenaue Übungen zum Blitzrechenkurs im Zahlenbuch und zur Blitzrechenkartei
• Mehrere Schwierigkeitslevel - vom Anfänger bis zum Profi
• Noch mehr Übungen zum automatisierenden Üben sowie zum Fördern und Fordern
• Tests zur Selbstkontrolle der Lernende
• Auswertungsmodul zur Lernstandskontrolle für Lehrende und Eltern
• Lustige Animationen, damit der Lernspaß nicht zu kurz kommt
• Selbstbestimmtes Lernen möglich

Bildungseinrichtungen können die Blitzrechnen-App in der Schulversion ganz einfach über das Volume Purchase Program im Apple School Manager im Bereich „Apps und Bücher“ erwerben. Beim Kauf von 20 oder mehr Lizenzen erhalten Bildungseinrichtungen einen Rabatt von 50%!
Für Eltern empfehlen wir die Standardversion der Blitzrechnen-App, mit der bei Bedarf einzelne Klassenstufen erworben werden können.

Wir freuen uns sehr über Feedback. Bei Fragen oder Anregungen informieren Sie sich bitte unter https://hilfe.klett.de bzw. schicken Sie uns eine Anfrage. Wenn Ihnen die App gefällt, freuen wir uns über eine entsprechende Bewertung.

name: Video Master Pro
description:
Mit Video Master Pro können Sie Ihren Videos hochwertige Hintergrundmusik hinzufügen. Sie können die Musik aufnehmen oder eine vorhandene Hintergrundmusik aus Ihrer Sammlung verwenden. Sie können Dateien verwalten und bearbeiten, wiedergeben oder hochladen. Video Master Pro ist die einzige App, die Sie für die Videowiedergabe und -bearbeitung benötigen.

App-Funktionen:
- Keine Werbung.
- Unbegrenzte Anzahl von Dateiübertragungen.
- Musik aufnehmen.
- Videos importieren.
- Laden Sie Videos aus der Cloud herunter.
- Hintergrundmusik einfügen.
- Konvertieren Sie Video in Audio.
- Hintergrundwiedergabe.
- Wiedergabeliste.
- Speichern Sie Videos in Dateien oder Kamerarollen.
- Lade deine Videos auf Youtube hoch.

So nehmen Sie Musik auf:
1. Nehmen Sie Ihre Musik auf.
2. Gehen Sie zur Registerkarte Dateien und wählen Sie "Importieren".
3. Von Cloud-Diensten herunterladen oder von der Kamerarolle importieren.
4. Tippen Sie auf die Schaltfläche "i".
5. Audio einfügen.

So konvertieren Sie Video in Audio:
1. Wechseln Sie zur Registerkarte Dateien.
2. Tippen Sie im Video auf die Schaltfläche "i".
3. Wählen Sie "In Audio konvertieren".

So spielen Sie Videos in einer Wiedergabeliste ab:
1. Wechseln Sie zur Registerkarte Wiedergabeliste.
2. Wählen Sie "Wiedergabeliste hinzufügen" und geben Sie einen neuen Namen ein.
3. Wählen Sie "Videos hinzufügen".
4. Wählen Sie die Videos aus und drücken Sie "Zurück".

name: IIWII
description:
IIWII is a minimalist camera app that brings the beauty of analog film photography to your iPhone.

IT IS WHAT IT IS — No complicated settings, no endless menus. Just point, shoot, and capture authentic moments with stunning film-inspired looks applied in real-time.

TIMELESS FILM LOOKS
• Carefully crafted presets inspired by classic film stocks
• Real-time preview — what you see is what you get
• Adjustable intensity for your perfect look
• Import your own .cube LUT files as custom looks
• Look Manager — create and fine-tune your looks with tone curves, color mixing, white balance and more
• Natural Processing — less computational overprocessing, more authentic camera feel

FULL MANUAL CONTROL
• White Balance, Shutter Speed, ISO and Focus
• Each parameter toggleable between Auto and Manual
• Swipe down to reveal, swipe up to hide

THOUGHTFUL FEATURES
• RAW+ Capture on all iPhones — save DNG files alongside your photo
• Portrait mode with natural depth-of-field blur
• Double Exposure — blend two shots into one, just like real film
• Self-Timer with 2, 5 or 10 second countdown
• Record video with real-time film looks applied
• Grid overlays and horizon level for composition
• Built-in gallery with sharing and favorites
• QR Code detection

DESIGNED FOR SIMPLICITY
• Clean, distraction-free interface
• Ambient light effect reacts to your camera feed (iOS 26)
• Quick preset switching with swipe gestures
• Double-tap to flip camera
• Edge exposure slider for precise control
• Customizable top bar — choose your controls
• Lock Screen camera with shared settings and looks

PRIVACY FIRST
• GPS tagging is optional and controllable
• Location data automatically removed when sharing (configurable)
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads — ever

IIWII respects your moments. No cloud uploads, no accounts, no subscriptions. Your photos stay on your device.

Capture what matters. It is what it is.

name: PhotoPills
description:
Entdecke wie einfach es ist Sonne, Mond oder Milchstraße weltweit zu fotografieren!

Ob erfahrener Fotograf, professioneller Videofilmer oder Neuling, PhotoPills sorgt dafür, dass du die Konzeption, Planung und Aufnahme von einzigartigen Bildern lieben wirst.

* Alles in einer einzigen App
Der erste 2D-kartenbasierte Sonne-, Mond- und Milchstraße-Planer - Schnellsuche von Sonne-, Mondkonstellationen - 3D-Augmented Reality: Sonne, Mond, Milchstraße, Himmelsäquator, Polarstern, Tiefenschärfe, Blickfeld - Fotoplaner - Tool zur Suche von Aufnahmeorten - Informationen: Sonnenauf/-untergang, Dämmerung, Goldene Stunde, Blaue Stunde - Informationen: Mondauf/-untergang, Supermondtermine, Mondkalender - Rechner: Zeitraffer, Sterne erkennen, Sternspuren, lange Belichtungszeiten, hyperfokale Tabellen, Tiefenschärfe, Blickfeld, Entfernung zum Motiv, Brennweite-Einstellung - Komplette Anleitung und vieles mehr...

* von Profis empfohlen
"PhotoPills - ein unersetzbares Werkzeug, das ich zur Planung jeder Aufnahme benutze." – Mark Gee, Astronomie-Fotograf des Jahres
“Ein Werkzeug, das jeder Fotograf haben sollte” – Kevin Raber, Luminous-landscape.com
"Es zahlt sich aus! Dank diesem Tool können wir immer wieder tolle Aufnahmen schnell planen; Bietet die besten Möglichkeiten, um kreativer vorzugehen."- José B. Ruiz, Innovationspreis, Naturfotograf des Jahres

* Übernimm die Kontrolle
Warst du schon einmal an einem Ort und hast dir gedacht: "Schade, der Mond ist nicht genau da, ... das wäre ein hervorragendes Foto!"? Und die Sonne? Und die Milchstraße? Lasse deiner Fantasie freien Lauf und berechne, wann genau das passiert:

- Stellen dir vor: die Milchstraße erscheint über eine zauberhafte Landschaft, der Vollmond geht unter einem geheimen Steinbogen unter, ein Sonnenaufgang zwischen zwei riesigen Felsen an einem Traumstrand, ein Sonnenuntergang über der Hauptstraße in deiner Heimatstadt oder ein spektakulärer Vollmond hinter einem nahe gelegenen Hügel.
- Plane: Einfach das Datum und die Uhrzeit der gewünschten Szene berechnen und effektiver arbeiten!
- Fotografiere: Geh einfach raus, tauche in die Natur ein und genieße es den perfekte Moment festzuhalten!

* Keine Enttäuschungen!
Berechne schnell, ob das Foto möglich ist oder nicht. Verschwende keine kostbare Zeit mehr mit langen Nachforschungen.

* Verpasse nie wieder die perfekte Szene
Erstelle eine To-Do-Liste von geplanten Fotos und fahre zum richtigen Zeitpunkt zum Aufnahmeort.

* Mach es perfekt
Wähle den perfekten Bildausschnitt schon vor der Aufnahme aus. Durch die 3D-Augmented Reality siehst du, ob die Sonne, der Mond, die Milchstraße, der Himmelsäquator und der Polarstern sich an der gewünschten Position befinden, wenn du den Auslöser drückst.

* Entdecke tolle Orte und füge sie zu deiner persönlichen Datenbank hinzu
Nutze PhotoPills, um einen Ort als POI zu speichern. Füge anschauliche Fotos und Notizen hinzu.

* Fokussiere dich auf deine Kreativität; überlasse das Rechnen den Nerds
- Berechne: Zeitraffer-Einstellungen, Langzeitbelichtungen, Sternspuren, die max. Belichtungszeit um Sterne als Punkte zu erfassen, Einstellungen für einen gewünschten Schärfegrad, Einstellungen für ein gewünschtes Sichtfeld, Objektivauswahl und Motivabstand für deinen Bildausschnitt, min. Abstand zum Motiv, entspr. Brennweite des Objektivs zur Reproduktion des Blickwinkels usw.
- Prognose: Positionen von Sonne, Mond, Milchstraße, Himmelsäquator und Polarstern.

* Teile deine Ergebnisse
Egal ob du deine Ergebnisse deinen Freunden, der Familie oder der ganzen Welt zeigen willst: PhotoPills hilft dir dabei. Teile deine Pläne, geheimen Orte und all die anderen Planungen auf Facebook, Twitter oder beiden in nur wenigen Schritten.

* Triff andere Fotografen
Teile deine Pläne und Orte via E-Mail. Lade deine Freunde ein dabei zu sein. Andere PhotoPillers können deine Planungen importieren und selbst betrachten.

Worauf wartest du? Hol dir PhotoPills gleich jetzt und mache wirklich einzigartig Aufnahmen!

name: Shorts Blocker for YouTube
description:
Entfernen Sie YouTube Shorts vollständig.

Sie werden Shorts nirgendwo sehen – kein Feed, keine Suchergebnisse, keine Empfehlungen.
Ein saubereres, ruhigeres YouTube-Erlebnis, ohne in ständige Scroll-Schleifen zu fallen.

Konzentrieren Sie sich auf das, was wichtig ist, ohne Ablenkungen durch Kurzformate.
Genießen Sie jedes Mal ein gezielteres YouTube-Erlebnis, wenn Sie browsen.

Bitte beachten: Der Shorts Blocker funktioniert ausschließlich mit dem Safari-Browser auf iPhone, iPad und Mac-Geräten und ist nicht mit der YouTube-App kompatibel.

name: Vinegar - Tube Cleaner
description:
Vinegar is a Safari extension that replaces the YouTube player with a minimal HTML video tag.

It removes ads, restores picture-in-picture, and allows videos to play in the background when set to audio-only quality.

Note: The phrase 'can read and alter webpages' in the permissions section is just an unfortunate choice of words. Vinegar needs access to the webpage to find the YouTube player and replace it. It's not doing anything creepy!

(Also, do check out Vinegar's companion app, Baking Soda. It's essentially a less powerful version of Vinegar, but it works on all websites except YouTube.)

name: Radio - Receiver

Receiver Radio ist ein Internetradio mit über 40.000 Radiosendern, über 25.000 Podcasts und einer Radioweckerfunktion. Mit Receiver Radio haben Sie eine viel größere Auswahl an Sendern als mit einem DAB- oder DAB+-Radio.

+ Suche nach Genre, Region, Sprache, Qualität, Beliebtheit neuer Sender etc.

+ Siri-Kurzbefehle
+ HomePod Unterstützung

name: AdGuard Pro: Safari Ad Blocker
description:
AdGuard ist ein sehr effektiver Werbeblocker für Safari. Es entfernt nicht nur lästige Anzeigen, sondern schützt auch Ihre Privatsphäre mithilfe eines erweiterten Tracking-Schutzes. AdGuard für iOS ist eine Open-Source-Anwendung, die völlig transparent und sicher zu benutzen ist. 
 
Die wichtigsten Funktionen:

- Anzeigenblockierung in Safari. Entfernt alle Arten der Anzeigen in Safari. Vergessen Sie lästige Banner, Pop-ups und Videoanzeigen. Setzen Sie Ihre Lieblings-Websites auf die Whitelist oder verwenden Sie das manuelle Blockierungs-Tool, um jedes Element auf der Seite zu verstecken.

- Privatsphärenschutz. Das Web ist voll von Trackern, die jeden Ihrer Klicks verfolgen. AdGuard bietet eine Reihe von Filtern, die sich direkt an Tracker und Web-Analytics richten und sicherstellen, dass Ihre persönlichen Daten privat bleiben.

- Geschwindigkeitsbeschleunigung. AdGuard entfernt Tonnen von Online-Müll, so dass Safari-Browser schneller läuft und Sie frei im Internet surfen können.

name: TonalEnergy Stimmgerät & Metro
description:
Für Musiker, ob Profi oder Anfänger, ob Sie singen, ein Blechblas-, Holzblas-, Saiteninstrument oder Gitarre spielen, diese App bietet funktionsreiche Übungs-Tools mit unterhaltsamem & lohnendem Feedback. So viel mehr als nur ein Stimmgerät! 
Was macht TonalEnergy zur meistverkauften Musik-Übungs-App? 

• Alles in einem: hochmodernes Stimmgerät, fortschrittliches Metronom, eigene Orchesterstreicher & Gitarrenstimmseite, Klaviatur, Klanganalyse-Seiten & Audio-/visuelle Aufnahmemöglichkeiten. 

• Einfach anzuwenden: Optionen wie Target Tuner oder Pitch Tracker auf allen Hauptseiten. TonalEnergy hilft Nutzern, lohnende & erreichbare Ziele für Proben oder eigenständiges Üben festzulegen. Bunte Analysen-Datenseiten & Funktionen zur Audio-/Video-Aufnahme erleichtern das Üben zusätzlich. 

• Innovatives Metronom. Beispiellose Flexibilität in Klangauswahl, Tempo-Einstellungen, Taktarten, Subdivisionsmustern & visuellen Anzeigen. Dank gesprochenem Einzählen, Erstellen & Bearbeiten von Voreinstellungsgruppen & Ableton Link zur Synchronisierung mehrerer Geräte ein hervorragendes Tool für Live-Musiker. 

• Endlose Möglichkeiten zur Schulung des Gehörs. Die hochwertigen, multi-gesampelten Instrumentenklänge für Symphonie-Instrumente sind einzigartig unter allen anderen Stimmgerät-Apps. Das Gehör kann mit einer 8-Oktaven-Klaviatur, einem chromatischen Rad & einem Tonerzeuger geschult werden.

• Lernen ist eine soziale Aktivität. Mit TonalEnergy Tuners einzigartigen Funktionen lassen sich Daten sammeln, prüfen, bearbeiten & mit anderen teilen. Für Konzertmusiker ist Feedback zur Weiterentwicklung ihrer Fähigkeiten entscheidend. Der Austausch steht im Zentrum. 

Chris Coletti, Mitglied von The Canadian Brass, fasst TonalEnergy so zusammen: 

“TonalEnergy ist ein Muss für jeden ernsthaften Musiker. Es bietet eine komplette Tool-Suite in nur einer App: Stimmgerät, Tonerzeuger, Aufnahmegerät, Metronom & die hübsche Oberfläche machen es zu einem der besten Tools für Musiker, die es gibt, Punkt.” 

FUNKTIONEN 

• Erkennt einen großen Tonhöhenbereich, auch in tieferen Stimmlagen als viele andere Stimmgeräte (C0-C8). Spricht bestens auf Blas-, Akustik- & elektrische Saiteninstrumente an 
• Anpassbarer Normalton A=440 Hz 
• Autom. oder manuelle Transpositionsoptionen 
• Wechselt sofort zwischen gleichstufigen, reinen & anderen benutzerdef. Stimmungen 
• Autom.- oder sofortige Normalton-Funktion mit TonalEnergy-Tönen 
• Umfassende Stimmliste für alle Orchestersaiten- & Saiteninstrumente mit Bünden, inkl. weit mehr Funktionen als die meisten anderen Stimmgeräte-Apps nur für Saiteninstrumente 
• Ausklappbare 8-Oktaven-Klaviatur bereichert viele wichtige Stimmfunktionen 
• Tongenerator am chromatischen Rad, mit optionaler autom. Vibrato-Funktion 
• Frequenz & Naturton-Grafiken mit multifunktionaler Wellenform 
• Spezielle Metronomseite, die die Funktionen aller anderen Metronom-Apps erfüllt oder überbietet 
• Notationsoptionen inkl. den Varianten Standard-Englisch, Solfège, Nordeuropäisch & Indisch 
• Bluetooth & andere Eingang-/Ausgangs-Unterstützung 
• Audio- & Video-Aufnahmefunktionen, inkl. Bearbeiten, Looping, Zeitdehnung, alles exportierbar über iTunes gemeinsamen Dateizugriff, AirDrop, E-Mail, AudioCopy, SoundCloud usw.

• Kompatibel mit externen Mikrofon- & Ansteck-Schwingungssensor-Geräten 
• Unterstützt externe Video-Ausgabe auf externem Display zur Nutzung in Proberäumen

• Universelle App, unterstützt alle Geräteausrichtungen 
• Audiobus- & Inter-App-Audio-Unterstützung 
• VoiceOver-Unterstützung für Blinde & Sehbehinderte 

INSTRUMENTE

• Sopran-, Alt-, Tenor- & Bariton-Saxophon

• Waldhorn

name: Sun Surveyor (Sonnenvermesser)
description:
Sun Surveyor sagt die Positionen von Sonne & Mond (Azimut, Höhe, Zeiten) vorher, mit Modulen für Kartenansicht, Kameraansicht (Augmented Reality) und Details (Ephemeris). Sun Surveyor hilft dabei, Standorte für Film und Fotografie zu finden, Solaranlagen zu positionieren, ist nützlich im Gartenbau, beim Immobilienhandel, für geowissenschaftlich Versierte und mehr! Bereiten Sie sich auf jeden Sonnenauf- und untergang vor!

Verwenden Sie interaktive Bedienelemente, um: 
- sich auf die „goldene Stunde“ vorzubereiten und diese zu visualisieren 
- den richtigen Zeitpunkt im Jahr und Winkel zu finden, um an einem Standort bei Sonnenauf- oder -untergang zu fotografieren oder zu filmen, oder um Motive mit dem Mond zu treffen 
- Sonne und Mond im Tages - oder Jahresverlauf für jeden Punkt auf der Erde zu visualisieren 
- mit der Augmented-Reality-Kameraansicht eine sphärische 360-Grad-Ansicht auf das Kamerabild zu projizieren
- Bereiten Sie Nachtaufnahmen mit Funktionen für Milchstraße und Sternspuren vor

Funktionen: 
- Peilung/Azimut und Höhe für Sonne & Mond, Sonnenauf- & -untergang, Schattenverhältnis, Mondauf- & -untergang, Mondphase & prozentuale Ausleuchtung, Dämmerungszeiten, Sommer- und Wintersonnenwendläufe, Zeiten für goldene und blaue Stunde , Wahrer Mittag
- Visualisierungen für Milchstraßenband und -zentrum, Himmelskompass zur Visualisierung von Sternspuren
- 3D-Kompass — Eine 3D-Projektion der Positionen von Sonne und Mond sowie von Ereignissen, überlagert auf einen Kompass, der die Ausrichtung und Neigung des Geräts in der realen Welt abbildet. 
- Kartenansicht — Eine Draufsicht auf die Positionen von Sonnen- und Mondereignissen, überlagert auf eine interaktive Karte.
- AR-Kameraansicht — Sehen Sie durch die Kamera Ihres Geräts, wo am Himmel Sonne und Mond stehen werden, oder wann sie hinter einem Gebäude verschwinden. 
- Street-View-Panoramen — Ein interaktives 360-Grad-Panorama (sofern verfügbar) aus der Kartenansicht für Ihren gewählten Standort heraus.
- Fotogelegenheiten — eine interaktive Liste markanter Zeitpunkte, die dabei helfen soll, zu inspirieren und Ideen für Fotos zu finden, einschließlich des die Landschaft während der magischen Stunde dominierenden Vollmonds, völliger Dunkelheit fürs Sternegucken, und mehr
- Positionssuche — ein exterm leistungsfähiges Werkzeug zur Suche nach Positionen von Sonne, Mond und dem Zentrum der Milchstraße unter Berücksichtigung verschiedener Randbedingungen, für den perfektionistischen Planer
- Import und Export von Standorten — Importieren Sie Google-Earth-Dateien mit Ortsmarken („*.kmz“/„*.kml“) und exportieren Sie Standorte zu Backup-Zwecken oder um sie mit Anderen zu teilen
- „Zeitmaschine“-Schieberegler — Visualisieren Sie Ereignisse eines einzelnen Tages, oder beobachten Sie, wie die Tage im Jahresverlauf länger oder kürzer werden und der Mondlauf variiert. 
- Offline-Nutzung (außer Kartenansicht) — Geben Sie Koordinaten ein, speichern & laden Sie Standorte, ohne dass eine Datenverbindung oder GPS-Verfügbarkeit erforderlich ist. 
- Verschicken Sie Bildschirmfotos und Details. - Sonnenschattenverhältnis und –Projektion — visualisieren Sie die von der Sonne geworfenen Schatten. 
- Lokale, automatisch detektierte oder manuelle Zeitzonen-Einstellung 
- Kompensation der magnetischen Missweisung

name: Pythonista 3
description:
Pythonista is a complete scripting environment for Python 3.10, running right on your iPad or iPhone, so you can develop and run Python scripts on the go.

Like Python itself, "batteries are included" – from popular third-party modules like requests, numpy, matplotlib, pandas (and many more) to modules that are tailor-made for iOS. With Pythonista, your scripts can access sensor/location data, your photo library, contacts, reminders, the clipboard, and more, allowing you to harness the full potential of both Python and iOS.

Pythonista is designed with a user-friendly interface that makes it easy for anyone to get started with coding, regardless of skill level. The complete Python documentation is also available for offline reading in the app.

Pythonista is not just for learning and practicing Python – it's also a powerful tool for automating iOS with multiple app extensions. You can invoke scripts directly from the share sheet or a custom system keyboard in almost any app, and integrate scripts with Shortcuts and Siri. With Pythonista, it's easy to run your scripts whenever you need them, without having to switch between different apps.

Features:

> Powerful code editor with syntax highlighting, code completion, and scripting support

> Interactive prompt with code completion, command history, and support for showing images

> Integrated visual debugger and object inspector

> Complete offline documentation with quick lookup directly from the editor

> Various beautiful light and dark color themes, and a theme editor to make your own

> UI editor for quick prototyping

> Integrated PEP 8 style checker and code formatter

> Supports most of the Python standard library and additional modules for graphics, sound, and iOS integration (for example clipboard, contacts, reminders, photos, ui...)

> Many popular third-party modules included, for example requests, numpy, matplotlib, pandas, Pillow...

> Lots of included examples

> Universal app for iPad and iPhone

> Share sheet extension for running scripts from almost any app

> Scriptable system-wide keyboard to use Python in any app that edits text

> Advanced integration with the Shortcuts app, allowing you to use Python scripts as actions in shortcuts and personal automations.

Please note that Pythonista is not designed to enable the installation or download of additional modules written in compiled languages (C/C++). While many popular native libraries are included and work out-of-the-box, it is generally not possible to install additional modules with C/C++ dependencies.

The name "Pythonista" is used with kind permission from the Python Software Foundation.

name: Speed-Tracker
description:
Enhance Your Driving Experience with Speed Tracker Speed Tracker is the ultimate app for car enthusiasts and performance drivers who want to monitor and analyze their driving with precision. Whether you're on a road trip, testing your car's limits, or simply commuting, Speed Tracker provides the insights you need to optimize your driving experience. All core features work out of the box - no account or subscription required.

Key Features:

Real-Time Driving Metrics:

Track your current speed, average speed, and maximum speed in real-time.
Monitor your journey with precise GPS location updates, even when the app is running in the background.
Follow your trip from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island with Live Activities, including distance, duration, average speed, and ETA status.
Optionally auto-start trips when you begin driving and end them when you park - even if the app was closed.

Shortcuts & Automation:
Set up CarPlay automations to automatically track trips when you connect or disconnect from your car.
Control tracking with Siri voice commands and Apple Shortcuts.

In-Depth Trip Analysis:
Access detailed summaries of each trip, including start and end times, total distance, and duration.
Analyze your route with comprehensive speed data and GPS coordinates.
Calculate estimated travel times and compare them with actual durations to gain insights into your travel efficiency and identify areas for improvement.
Create share cards from any trip - polished route, compact, or overlay graphics ready to send to friends or post online.

Interactive Map Visualizations:
Visualize your routes on a dynamic map with speed-based coloring to identify high-speed segments.
Customize speed ranges for map coloring, or use Autobahn-optimized presets.

Comprehensive Driving Statistics:
View detailed statistics on total distance, duration, average speed, and top speed.
Explore highlights, ETA comparison, cruising insights, streaks, and tag breakdowns.
Identify high-speed segments with customizable speed thresholds, perfect for performance analysis.

Trip History & Management:
Browse through your trip history with advanced sorting and filtering options.
Tag trips for better organization and quick access.
Sync and back up your trips with iCloud for seamless access across all your devices.

Speed Tracker Social (subscription required):
Share your trips with friends or drivers worldwide and see how you compare.
Watch friends - and drivers sharing worldwide - live on the map with real-time speed, route, and ETA.
Auto-share completed drives with friends and get alerts when someone is driving live.
React to shared trips, build your driver profile, connect with friends, and explore their drives.
Add cars to your Garage and attach them when you share.
Compare on global and country leaderboards in categories like total distance, peak speed, drive time, average speed, ETA comparison, and longest trip.
Social features require a monthly or yearly subscription. All core tracking, analysis, and statistics features remain fully available without a subscription.

Why Choose Speed Tracker? Speed Tracker is specifically designed for car drivers who demand precision and detail in their driving data. Whether you're aiming to improve your driving performance, track your road trips, or simply keep a log of your daily commutes, Speed Tracker provides the tools you need to gain valuable insights and make informed decisions. With Live Activities, smarter statistics, share cards, and optional auto-start tracking, every drive is easier to follow and revisit. And with Speed Tracker Social - including Live Drives, auto-share, and leaderboards - you can join a community of drivers, share your trips, and see how others drive.

Download Speed Tracker today and take your driving experience to the next level!

name: IHK.AEVO Trainieren – Testen
summary: Train and test your AEVO-knowledge for the "training of trainers".
description:
With over 500 tasks, you can easily check your knowledge of the “training of trainers” according to the Trainer Suitability Ordinance (AEVO). 

This is what the app offers:

- Expand your knowledge with the help of the flashcards: The tasks are displayed directly to you with the correct answers.
- Test your knowledge with interactive tasks: choose the correct solution from several answer options and compare the correct solutions with your own answers. Get an overview of your current level of knowledge.
- Learn in a targeted manner by selecting fields of action or putting together tasks across fields of activity.
- Deepen your knowledge with the help of 400 glossary entries on all important terms relating to AEVO.
- Create your own flashcards or tasks.

As a future trainer, you will gain confidence in dealing with all aspects of the training when working on the tasks. The contents of the regulation (basis for the review) or the framework plan are largely reflected. In this respect, the tasks are divided into the four fields of action of the AEVO:

- Check training requirements and plan training,
- prepare training and participate in the recruitment of trainees,
- carry out training,
- Complete training.

Please note that the tasks are not original examination tasks. These will not be published. The legal status is January 1st, 2025.

The terms of use for using the app can be found here.
https://www.dihk-bildungs-gmbh.de/ueber-uns/ihk-aevo-app-trainieren-und-testen

“It’s all a matter of attitude”:
You can decide for yourself how you want to learn via “Settings”. In the test section you can choose between power or sequence mode.

1. Power mode:
In power mode, you repeat questions several times. The more often you answer a question correctly, the less often it will appear. The perfect memory training! No matter how long you study, the algorithm records your learning level based on the probability that a question will be shown again. You can interrupt at any time, switch between fields of action or combine fields of action with one another.

2. Sequence mode:
In sequence mode, you simply work on all questions one after the other. You can have the tasks presented either in a given or random order.

In order to have learning content and your results up to date on all your mobile devices, you can synchronize them by setting up a user account.

Have fun learning with the IHK-AEVO app!

name: MobileSheets
summary: MobileSheets is a sheet music viewer with powerful tools for musicians.
description:
MobileSheets is the ultimate sheet music viewer for Android tablets. It frees you from having to lug around books and binders, and gives you the ability to access any score in your library in seconds. It also comes with a number of powerful features for musicians including:
    - Multiple modes of operation including two pages side-by-side, half page turns, and vertically scrolling pages.
    - Hands-free page turns using any bluetooth or usb devices (including two and four pedal models), through the automatic scrolling feature, or through face gestures such as an open mouth or smile.
    - Annotations for marking up music including support for freeform drawing, basic shapes, text and stamps
    - A custom audio player for playing audio tracks with your scores. Audio player supports a-b looping and multiple sizes.
    - Custom page ordering, making it easy to cut out unnecessary pages, repeat pages or change the sequence of pages without affecting the original document.
    - A metronome with multiple display modes and sound effects
    - Bookmarks for quick and easy access to sections in scores
    - Link points for handling repeats and quickly jumping between pages
    - Smart buttons that can be placed on a score to activate configurable actions when pressed
    - Support for multiple file types including images, PDFs, text files and chord pro files. 
    - Support for importing CSV index files to break up large PDF songbooks
    - Support for communicating with MIDI devices over USB to load songs or trigger actions.
    - The ability to transpose chords in text and chord pro files.
    - Manual and automatic cropping to completely eliminate unnecessary margins
    - Support for setlists and collections to efficiently group songs for playback. 
    - Powerful library management features with a huge list of supported metadata fields, giving you complete control over the data in your library
    - A free companion application for the PC that makes it a breeze to create and edit songs
    
MobileSheets acts as a file manager for your sheet music files (PDFs, images or text/chord pro files) and links directly to them on the device. It provides a way to organize and quickly access any of those files. MobileSheets can be configured to use existing files and folders on the device storage, allowing those files to be organized as desired by the user without them having to be copied or moved.

Give MobileSheets a try today and experience the freedom of having all your scores just a simple tap away.
    
NOTE: This application is designed and optimized for 7" and larger tablets. This application does not include any sheet music - you must provide your own. This application can not play back PDFs, images or text/chord pro files. It can only display those files and play back audio files.

For E-Ink devices, a special e-ink version is available. Contact support@zubersoft.com for more information.

The companion app is for your PC and is not included. You can download the companion app for free here: http://www.zubersoft.com/mobilesheets/companion.html

name: IHK. 34a GewO
summary: 640 test questions for information according to § 34a GewO available on- or offline
description:
The provider of the app is a non-profit GmbH and not a government institution. All content is based on publicly available information and the requirements of the Security Ordinance (BewachV) in its current version. You can view the current version of the regulation on the following website of the Federal Ministry of Justice: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bewachv_2019/BJNR069200019.html. Despite the greatest care in preparing the questions, no guarantee can be given that the content is correct, complete and up-to-date or that it corresponds to the legal requirements.

Test and train your knowledge with over 640 questions for 40 hours of training in the security industry. This helps you prepare for all security tasks for which no expertise test is required in accordance with Section 34a GewO.

The test questions were developed to support understanding and knowledge in accordance with the Security Ordinance (BewachV) and Section 34a GewO. Please note that these questions are intended as a study aid and are not the official exam questions.

According to the security regulations, the questions are divided into the following subject areas: 
   • Law of public safety and order
   • Commercial law 
   • Data protection 
   • Civil Code 
   • Criminal law and criminal procedure law
   • Handling weapons
   • Accident prevention regulations
   • Dealing with people
   • Basic principles of safety technology

Please note that the questions in this app serve as learning support for instruction in the security industry and are not exam questions for the expertise test according to GewO § 34a. This makes them different from the official exam tasks, which often have a higher level of difficulty. For comprehensive preparation for the knowledge test, we recommend additional courses and specialized learning materials.

When I start the app, I am automatically in training mode, but I can switch to test mode at any time with just a few clicks. In training mode, like with flashcards, I only see the correct answer.  In test mode, I decide on an answer and receive immediate feedback. Alternatively, I can display the correct answer without attempting a solution.

I can decide how I design my test with each test run:
   • I choose questions from just one, several or all subject areas. The orange tick next to the subject areas shows me what has been “actively” selected.
   • I test my knowledge in either power or sequence mode.

Power mode is preset when you start the app. However, I can switch to order mode at any time via Settings.

Power mode: Depending on my test success, the questions are repeated more or less frequently. Questions answered incorrectly appear more often than those answered correctly. The questions are repeated until all have been answered correctly. 

I can influence the probability of resubmission via settings: 
   1. about the “degree of probability” the intervals at which the questions will be presented again 
   2. via the “activation buffer” the number of questions per test run.

Sequence mode: Here I can display the test questions either in a given or random order. I can also set this via settings.
 
What other advantages does the app offer?
   • Display of the current knowledge and processing status either per test run or since the first start of the app.
   • Updating the question pool via “synchronization”
   • Parallel use of the app on all mobile devices I use

We strive to update the question pool regularly to ensure the relevance and accuracy of the content. Please check the app regularly for updates to ensure you have access to the latest information.

• Tone bursts — transients and decay

• 1/3-octave band noise — 32 ISO 266 bands
• Polarity test — L/R phase check

STEREO TOOLS

• Auto L/R — hands-free alternation between the speakers
• Per-driver band noise — sub, woofer, midrange and tweeter presets
• Anti-phase sine and a subsonic / high-pass finder

WHY TUNEHELPER
• 100% real-time synthesis — every signal generated live, never a looped buffer

• Background audio — keeps playing with the screen locked

PRIVACY
No accounts, no tracking, no data collection. All settings stay on your device.

You bring the mic and REW — TuneHelper brings lab-grade signals to the driver's seat.

summary: Tap away arrows to escape the maze. Train your brain with smart puzzle games!
description:
Arrow Puzzle is a single-player logic game that turns simple taps into a rewarding challenge. Your goal is straightforward: find a free path, tap arrows in the right order, and enjoy as the maze slowly turns into a clear, empty board on every level. Follow the arrows to escape the puzzle and find a soothing flow that keeps your mind engaged and relaxed.

Looking for a gentle workout for your brain without any pressure attached? This comforting single-player arrow game lets you tap away the stress, gives you a focused break from the noise, and helps you train your logic and spatial thinking as you build a calming daily ritual. Inspired by abstract graphic games, each cleared board in the arrow game is a small mental reset—a satisfying win for your mind.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others. Clean visuals inspired by abstract graphic games help you focus on every move.
• Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
• If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
• Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and master this abstract graphic puzzle game one level at a time.

Ranked ladders and arenas introduce new obstacles, tighter matchups and fresh unit unlocks the deeper you climb. How to play Crossword Master:

- Your goal in this turn-based word game is to craft words on the crossword board according to the clues and outscore your opponent.
- Use blue cells with clues to guess words in this engaging crossword puzzle game. Find the right fit for each letter from a set of five and place them one by one from the deck to start forming words.

Every correct letter earns one point, with additional points awarded for completing words. The score for a whole word equals the number of letters it contains. description:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

name: Jam Bus:Sandfall
summary: A relaxing bus jam puzzle with sand layers, colors, and smart routes.
description:
Jam Bus: Sandfall brings a fresh twist to bus jam, color puzzle, and traffic escape gameplay.
Colorful sand is stacked in layers, and every bus has its own color and direction. Tap the right bus, collect the matching sand, and clear the board step by step. Sounds simple at first, but every move can change the whole puzzle.
Plan carefully before you tap. Some buses may block each other. Some paths may cross. Some sand colors can only be cleared after the lower layers are gone. To win, you need to observe the board, choose the right order, and keep every bus moving without a crash.
How to play
• Tap a bus to move it along its route
 • Match each bus with the same color sand
 • Clear lower sand layers to unlock the ones above
 • Avoid traffic crashes when paths cross
 • Solve each level with smart sequencing
Why you’ll enjoy Jam Bus: Sandfall
• Easy tap controls
 • Relaxing color-matching gameplay
 • Clever bus parking jam puzzles
 • Satisfying sand-clearing effects
 • Increasingly tricky routes and layers
 • Clean visuals and smooth puzzle flow
 • Great for quick breaks and brain training
Every level is a small logic challenge. A bus may look ready to move, but its route might block another vehicle. A color may be visible, but the sand below it must be cleared first. Think ahead, follow the arrows, and find the perfect order to clear the whole sandfall.
If you enjoy bus games, parking jam puzzles, color sort games, traffic escape challenges, or relaxing logic games, Jam Bus: Sandfall gives you a colorful new puzzle to solve.
Start with one bus, clear one color, and let the sand fall into place.

summary: Collect and assemble powerful heroes, build your base, and fight monsters
description:
Empires & Puzzles is an innovative match-3 puzzle game where puzzle-solving meets deep fantasy RPG, combining RPG elements, PvE quests, and base-building — topped off with epic head to head duels that range from riveting 1v1 Raids to large-scale 100v100 Wars.

• Match-3 battles with real strategy
Match Shields to deal damage and power up each Hero's Special Skill, then unleash combos at the perfect moment. Learn the five-element color wheel and turn the board into your weapon. Achieve huge combos to take down even the most powerful enemies!

• Explore richly themed worlds — plus many dozens of mythical quests
Prepare for an epic match-3 adventure that will take you through all sorts of worlds for a genuine RPG experience! Will your team be strong and sturdy enough to sail stormy seas, fend against underworld monsters, crawl through sandy dungeons, and slay titanic dragons — while also making tons of new friends along the way?

• Hero Collection
Hundreds of legendary heroes and dozens of mighty troops await collection — summon new allies to bolster your team and unlock new strategy options! Each hero comes with their own unique stats and skills — discover hero synergies and unlock their strengths to victory.

• Base-building
Rebuild the ruins of a mighty castle and turn it into your own war fortress! A finely built Stronghold will provide all the tools you need to gather resources, level up armies, craft useful items, train your heroes, and serve as a place of refuge as you fight the forces of evil.

• Play together
Join an Alliance and team up with other real players to get the best rewards in the game! Strong bonds will naturally form and evolve once you start playing together — whether it be fighting epic titans, strategizing in multiplayer wars, exploring treacherous islands full of monsters, or competing in Alliance Quests, you'll improve at the game, earn awesome rewards, and make friends along the way.

• Farming, crafting, upgrading
Make sure your team is well-prepared for all the adventures out there! Level up your Stronghold and gather valuable resources — such as Dragon Bones and Meteor Fragments — to craft legendary weapons that will help your heroes make it through even the toughest battles.

• Amazing graphics
This puzzle RPG is set in a beautifully rendered fantasy world — you'll marvel at the stunning details of countless monsters, dragons, and other fantasy creatures! Your heroes' powerful magic spells will not only dazzle your eyes but also dramatically turn the tides of wars.

• Train and dress up
Unlike in ordinary hero card games, you can level up your "deck" of heroes — and even evolve their power further by equipping them with costumes that add to their power! The vast fantasy world of Empires & Puzzles will present a wide array of challenges; you'll want to build an army that can tackle any opponent that comes your way.

Empires & Puzzles is the perfect game for:

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

summary: Millions of crafters have smashed billions of blocks! Now you can join the fun!
description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting, and survival in the ultimate sandbox adventure. Gather resources, survive the night, and build a world one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a block city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!
 
Craft a new house, build a block city, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream avatar world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer games with friends on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated game 3D world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!
 
BUILD YOUR DREAM WORLD
• Build a block city, a house, or create an entire game world from the ground up
• Building simulator games for kids, adults, or anyone
• Craft and build from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes
• Explore an endless open world simulation full of different biomes and creatures
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace
• Private and community servers – Online village building game allows you to connect with millions of players, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server
• Slash commands – Tweak how the 3D game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more
• Add-ons – Block builders can customize their experience even further with add-ons as they build up! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your 3D game to create new resource packs
 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES
• Play with friends and other builders when you join our free massive multiplayer servers
• Multiplayer game servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Explore endless realms through multiplayer games with friends. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you

name: Rogue Legend - Roguelike RPG
summary: Action roguelike RPG with upgrades, boss fights, and idle progression!
description:
Embark on an action roguelike RPG adventure with Rogue Legend, where every battle makes your hero stronger.
In Rogue Legend, you journey through worlds filled with monsters, treasures, and powerful bosses. Each run is a new roguelike RPG experience of strategy, combat, and growth, giving you the chance to strengthen your hero and push further with every run.

Enter a World of Endless Battles:
Every session begins in the lobby. Press Play and roll the dice to start your roguelike RPG run, diving into a board-based action RPG full of encounters and surprises. As your hero moves across the board, different events unfold depending on where you land:
* Enemy Tiles: Engage in fast, automatic roguelike RPG battles. After each fight, choose one of three upgrades to shape your build.
* Buff Tiles: Gain boosts to attack, defense, and speed to help your hero survive longer in Rogue Legend’s idle-friendly dungeons.
* Negative Tiles: Face debuffs that test your timing and strategic decisions.
* Minigame Tiles: Roll for luck in short events where you can win extra loot or power-ups.
* Shop Tiles: Spend gold to buy new gear, upgrades, and legendary equipment.
* Special Tiles: Additional tile types will be added over time to expand Rogue Legend’s gameplay depth.

Defeat Bosses and Grow Stronger:
Your goal is to survive, adapt, and conquer every boss battle. Each fight is an opportunity to grow stronger, unlocking new roguelike RPG challenges, rewards, and abilities that prepare your hero for the next run in this idle RPG adventure.

Upgrade, Progress, and Customize Your Hero:
Between runs, return to the lobby to enhance your hero through Rogue Legend’s RPG progression systems:
* Gear System: Collect and upgrade your weapons, armor, and equipment. Collect S weapons!
* Talent System: Level up to unlock new stats, passive abilities, and bonuses that fit your playstyle.
* Pet System: Obtain and train pets that join you in combat.
* Hero Collection: Collect more heroes to unlock new strategies, then level and ascend them to raise their base power. Swap heroes to match different boards, enemies, and builds.
* Mounts: Equip & ride mounts that grant powerful stat bonuses and combat perks
* …and more progression systems to discover as you climb!


Roguelike Depth with Idle RPG Progression
Rogue Legend blends the excitement of roguelike gameplay with the satisfaction of RPG and idle progression. Each run feels fast, rewarding, and different. The board and dice mechanics make every move matter, while the idle RPG design ensures steady progress without repetitive grind.

A Journey of Strategy and Power:
If you enjoy roguelike action, RPG adventure, and idle gameplay, Rogue Legend delivers a journey of endless replayability.
⚔️ Fight, roll, and rise again in Rogue Legend, the roguelike idle RPG where every battle shapes your hero’s fate.

name: Butcher Hero: Monster Idle RPG
summary: Hook monsters in the sand, earn XP, upgrade gear and grow in an idle action RPG.
description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

Play your way

• Chain-hook combat built around pulling enemies into range
• Devour power and turn every hunt into permanent growth
• Upgrade damage, speed, armor, and health
• Collect gear and customize your loadout
• Fight monsters, aliens, elite enemies, and giant bosses
• Climb the Boss Tower and complete quests
• Earn crystals, open chests, and improve the Soul Graph
• Make progress with AFK progression and optional auto-battle
• Enjoy the complete single-player game offline
• Challenge other heroes in online PvP

Start small, hunt smarter, and become the hero no monster can stop. Hook the enemy, steal its power, upgrade your build, and turn every fight into permanent growth.

name: Star Trek Fleet Command
summary: Star Trek: Fleet Command.  Strategy MMO set in the official Star Trek universe.
description:
Welcome to Star Trek: Fleet Command - an immersive, online open world intergalactic strategy game! Strategically harness your combat, diplomatic, and leadership abilities to conquer the universe.

Embark on your journey in the Star Trek universe. Command your ship, crew, and fleet in a quest for peace and power. Download Star Trek Fleet Command today and boldly go where no one has gone before!

name: ChatGPT
summary: Your AI assistant for writing, search, image generation, and more
description:
Introducing ChatGPT for Android: OpenAI’s latest advancements at your fingertips.

This official app is free, syncs your history across devices, and brings you the latest from OpenAI, including the new image generator.

With ChatGPT in your pocket, you’ll find:

· Image generation–Generate original images from a description, or transform existing ones with a few simple words. 
· Advanced Voice Mode–Tap the soundwave icon to have a real-time convo on the go. Settle a dinner table debate, or practice a new language. 
· Photo upload—Snap or upload a picture to transcribe a handwritten recipe or get info about a landmark. 
· Creative inspiration—Find custom birthday gift ideas or create a personalized greeting card.
· Tailored advice—Talk through a tough situation, ask for a detailed travel itinerary, or get help crafting the perfect response. 
· Personalized learning—Explain electricity to a dinosaur-loving kid or easily brush up yourself on a historic event.
· Professional input—Brainstorm marketing copy or map out a business plan.

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: Flo Zyklus- & Periodenkalender
summary: Kalender für Perioden und Eisprung. Menstruations-Tracker und Pillen-Erinnerung.
description:
Flo ist ein Periodenkalender, ein Eisprung-Tracker und eine App für Fruchtbarkeit und Schwangerschaft, entwickelt für das Tracken deines Zyklus und genutzt von über 500 Millionen Menschen weltweit.* 

Mit dieser Zyklus-App verfolgst du deine Periode, sagst den Eisprung voraus, lernst, deine fruchtbaren Anzeichen zu erkennen, und entdeckst Symptome der Perimenopause. Flo begleitet deine Frauengesundheit in jeder Lebensphase.

🔒 Sind meine Daten bei Flo sicher? 

Ja. Das Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsprogramm von Flo wurde mehrfach ausgezeichnet, und Flo ist die erste App zur Zyklusverfolgung, die sowohl nach ISO 27001 als auch nach ISO 27701 zertifiziert ist – den internationalen Goldstandards im Datenschutz.

- Anonymer Modus: Nutze Flo, ohne dass deine Identität mit deinen Gesundheitsdaten verknüpft wird. Niemand, nicht einmal wir, kann dich identifizieren
- Verschlüsselung auf jeder Ebene: dieselben Standards, die auch von Banken und Behörden verwendet werden
- Transparenz: Unser Trust & Safety Hub und die Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsseite in der App geben dir alle wichtigen Informationen an einem Ort

🌸 Warum Flo als Periodenkalender und Eisprung-Tracker wählen? 

Mehr als ein einfacher Menstruationskalender: Als Periode-Tracker hilft Flo dir, Muster in deinem Menstruationszyklus über die Zeit zu erkennen.

- Über 70 Symptome und Stimmungen zum Tracken, darunter dein Ausfluss, für persönliche Einblicke
- Unterstützung bei unregelmäßigen Perioden und Veränderungen des Zyklus
- Klare Zusammenfassungen von dem, was du erfasst hast, die du mit einer ärztlichen Fachperson teilen kannst

👶 Kann Flo mir helfen, mich in meiner Kinderwunschzeit informiert zu fühlen?

Flo bietet edukative Funktionen, damit du deinen Menstruationszyklus und deinen Eisprung besser verstehst.

- Vorhersagen für das Eisprungfenster, basierend auf deinen erfassten Daten
- Tracken der Basaltemperatur (BBT) und des Zervixschleims

🐣 Wie unterstützt Flo meine Schwangerschaft Woche für Woche? 

Nach der Empfängnis wechselst du zum Modus „Schwangerschaft verfolgen“ und erhältst eine strukturierte, wöchentliche Begleitung.

- Schwangerschafts-Tracking mit wöchentlichen Updates zur Entwicklung deines Babys
- Visuals und Diagramme, die Veränderungen erklären

👩 Kann Flo mir bei Symptomen der Perimenopause helfen? 

Verfolge die Veränderungen dieser Lebensphase mit dafür entwickelten Tools.

- Perimenopause-Score, um zu erkunden, wie sich häufige Symptome auf den Alltag auswirken können
- Menopause-Zeitachse, um die Phasen der Perimenopause zu verstehen

💚 Ist Flo kostenlos? 

Flo ist als kostenloser Periodenkalender erhältlich, mit allen wichtigen Tools, um deinen Zyklus zu verstehen.

📚 Was bietet Flo Premium?

- Täglich personalisierte Einblicke und Videos von Fachpersonen
- Ausführliche Funktionen für jede Phase der Schwangerschaft
- Erinnerungen für die Pille und das Tracken der Periode
- Aufklärung mit Einblicken in die Fruchtbarkeit
- Virtueller Gesundheitsassistent rund um die Uhr für Aufklärung und Informationen zu PMS, unregelmäßigen Zyklen und mehr
- Flo für Paare: Teile Zyklus-Vorhersagen oder den Verlauf deiner Schwangerschaft mit deinem Herzensmenschen

Medizinischer Hinweis
